text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Streaming API p99 latency spike detected in us-west-2. P99 jumped to 1.9s (baseline 450ms). Increased error/retry rate observed. Possible correlation with prefix cache miss rate rising from 8% -> 55% on shard prefix-12.

sre-ana: seeing it in dashboards, p95 also creeping. paging stalls show long tail on KV lookup step.

oncall-aaron: I'm on call. grabbing traces now. any recent deploys to routing/prefix hashing?

runtime-chris: there was a small rollout 6m ago that bumped prefix-hash mapping algorithm to v2 for rolling shards (prefix-mapper:v2). Rolling ~20% of traffic to v2. Might be related.

prod-liz: customer-facing queued messages from a couple of enterprise customers in us-west. CS, heads up.

cs-maya: noted. contacting impacted accounts to set expectations. No major incidents reported yet but some elevated latency notes.

oncall-aaron: OK... quick mitigation options: 1) pause prefix-mapper:v2 rollout; 2) force fallback to prefix cache warmup; 3) route to larger shard with cold cache.

runtime-chris: can pause via rollout flag. Command:
```
./infra/rolloutctl pause --service=prefix-mapper --tag=v2 --region=us-west-2
```
I can run if SRE gives go.

sre-ana: run it. also enabling more aggressive prefetch for prefix-12 to warm caches.

deploy-bot: Deploy paused by oncall-aaron at 2026-03-14T15:12:03Z

oncall-aaron: paused. will monitor hit-rate. also enabling fallback route to legacy-cache (lower qps) for streaming endpoints:
```
routeset update streaming --region us-west-2 --policy fallback:legacy-cache
```

runtime-chris: started cache warmup job targeting prefix-12. warming 10k prefixes:
```
jobctl start --job=prefix-warmup --shard=prefix-12 --count=10000
```

sre-ana: telemetry: prefix miss rate dropped from 55% -> 18% after pause+warmup within 90s. p99 down to 720ms, p95 260ms. Still above baseline but improving.

prod-liz: thx. I'll hold on customer comms pending stabilization. any rollback of config planned?

runtime-chris: we'll roll prefix-mapper:v2 back in canary after fixing the hash edge-case. creating PR for deterministic shard assignment. For now we keep v2 paused.

cs-maya: flagged impacted customers for follow-up. no escalations yet.

oncall-aaron: handing off to night SRE - @sre-jordan, you're up. Summary: prefix-mapper:v2 rollout caused cache fragmentation on prefix-12 leading to high miss rate -> p99 spikes. We paused rollout and warmed cache; metrics improving. Keep watch on p99, cache hit-rate, streaming stalls. Estimated customer impact: elevated latency for ~10% of streaming requests in us-west for ~8min window.

sre-jordan: taking it. will watch for regressions and reconvene if p99 climbs >1s.

sre-ana: adding post-incident todo: 1) add canary threshold gating for prefix-hash rollouts (miss-rate delta), 2) add automated rollback when p99 > 1s for 2 min, 3) add synthetic warming job pre-rollout.

prod-liz: also add customer-impact dashboard for streaming endpoints.

oncall-aaron: linking traces and dashboards: https://dash.redwood.example/streams/us-west-2/trace/1852504321

runtime-chris: PR link for fix: https://git.redwood.example/prefix-mapper/pulls/459

sre-ana: will open incident ticket and assign Sev2. tagging for postmortem tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0314-17 | Severity: S2 | Owner: sre-ana

cs-maya: I'll follow up with customers and share incident note template.

oncall-aaron: thanks team. leaving notes in handoff channel. please escalate if p99 > 1s or miss-rate > 30% for >3m.

sre-jordan: acknowledged. monitoring alerts tuned. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Note: rollout resumes require explicit approval after warmup verification.

sre-ana: postmortem outline: timeline, root cause (prefix-mapper hashing edge-case), mitigations applied, code fix PR, monitoring/automation actions. Assigning owners.

cs-maya: drafting customer-facing note.

oncall-aaron: handoff complete. ending thread.
